## CredentialsModule.negotiateOffer() method

Negotiate a credential offer as holder (by sending a credential proposal message) to the connection associated with the credential record.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
negotiateOffer(credentialRecordId: string, preview: CredentialPreview, config?: {
        comment?: string;
        autoAcceptCredential?: AutoAcceptCredential;
    }): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter          | Type                                                                                                 | Description                                                       |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| credentialRecordId | string                                                                                               | The id of the credential record for which to accept the offer     |
| preview            | [CredentialPreview](./core.credentialpreview.md)                                                     | The new preview for negotiation                                   |
| config             | { comment?: string; autoAcceptCredential?: [AutoAcceptCredential](./core.autoacceptcredential.md); } | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the request |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)&gt;

Credential record associated with the sent credential request message
